_doc: Config-as-data Surface definitions for the DepWatch Surface Crunch. The Survey workflow reads this file to know which Surfaces to enumerate. Operator overrides live in ~/.claude/DOS/USER/SKILLCUSTOMIZATIONS/DepWatch/sources.json. Pattern: MEMORY/CANONICAL/surface-crunch-pattern.md
domain: dependency releases, CVEs and breaking changes in a project dependency tree

inward_surfaces.label: Installed dependency set (package.json + lockfile)
inward_surfaces.locator: <repo>/package.json plus the lockfile (package-lock.json | pnpm-lock.yaml | yarn.lock | bun.lock)
inward_surfaces.extraction_contract: Enumerate name, ecosystem, current_version, dependency_type, declared_range per dependency — see Survey.md Step 1 Inward Extraction Contract. This inventory is the Target set every Outward Thread maps onto.

outward_surfaces.label: npm + GitHub security advisories
outward_surfaces.locator: GitHub Advisory Database (https://github.com/advisories) + the GitHub GraphQL securityVulnerabilities API; npm audit
outward_surfaces.extraction_contract: CVE/GHSA findings per installed dependency — id, severity, affected_range, fixed_version. kind=cve.

outward_surfaces.label: Dependency GitHub releases & changelogs
outward_surfaces.locator: https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/releases and CHANGELOG.md per installed dependency above current_version
outward_surfaces.extraction_contract: New release tags above current_version — version, breaking-change flag, one-line summary. kind=release or breaking.

outward_surfaces.label: npm deprecation notices
outward_surfaces.locator: npm registry metadata (the 'deprecated' field) per installed package
outward_surfaces.extraction_contract: Deprecation notices — package, deprecated version range, suggested replacement. kind=deprecation.
